clauses.title: Assignment unit
clauses.normative_statement: Assignment unit is derivable only with factor and levels, an assignment event or equivalent mechanism, a candidate unit, and separability support.

required_predicates.rationale: A factor relevant to the inferential query must be identified.
At least two factor levels must be defined for the contrast.
Assignment requires an event or an explicitly equivalent mechanism.
The unit receiving assignment must be identified.
Separability must be supported; keywords or a well label are insufficient.

forbidden_inferences: Do not infer assignment independence from keywords, well identity, or biological-source independence.

clauses.title: Experimental unit
clauses.normative_statement: Experimental unit is derivable when the relevant treatment is assigned and realized separably at the candidate unit.

required_predicates.rationale: The query-relevant treatment assignment must be identified.
The realized application or exposure must be represented.
The candidate unit must be identified independently of source lineage.
Assignment must be separable at the candidate unit.
Realized exposure must preserve separability at the candidate unit.

forbidden_inferences: Do not use biological-source independence as assignment independence and do not change EU automatically for interference.

review_requirements.rationale: No universal reviewed mapping from unknown interference topology to effective exposure unit exists.

clauses.title: Experimental-unit count
clauses.normative_statement: Experimental-unit count is the number of distinct experimental-unit instances in the query contrast and pertinent lifecycle scope, per group or paired set.

required_predicates.rationale: Distinct experimental-unit instances must be identified.
The count must be scoped to an InferentialQuery.
The factor contrast must be explicit.
The pertinent planned or executed lifecycle phase must be explicit.
The group or paired-set scope must be explicit.

forbidden_inferences: Repeated measures, cells, fields, and analytical rows do not multiply experimental-unit count.

clauses.title: Biological-source count
clauses.normative_statement: Biological-source count derives exclusively from confirmed provenance and remains distinct from experimental-unit count.

required_predicates.rationale: Source lineage must be confirmed rather than inferred from an identifier.
Distinct biological-source instances must be represented.
The source count must be reported in query scope.

forbidden_inferences: Biological-source count does not automatically modify experimental-unit count.

clauses.title: Interference and estimand support
clauses.normative_statement: Interference status changes exposure, estimand, or scope consequences; no-known-path is not proof of absence and documented interference requires exposure mapping.

required_predicates.rationale: Interference must be represented as no-known-path, possible, documented, or unknown.
The consequence must be scoped to the query.
The rule must state whether the claim depends on a no-interference assumption.

forbidden_inferences: Do not treat no-known-path as absence and do not automatically change experimental unit for interference.

review_requirements.rationale: Unsupported exposure topology cannot select an effective exposure unit or alter EU automatically.

clauses.title: Analytical dependence
clauses.normative_statement: Analytical grouping, repeated measures, and measurement dependence generate analytical findings and statistical handoff without modifying EU or source count.

required_predicates.rationale: Grouping or aggregation used for analysis must be represented.
Repeated or correlated measurement status must be represented.
The measurement or analytical pipeline must be identified.
The analytical consequence must be query scoped.

forbidden_inferences: Analytical dependence cannot create or eliminate experimental units or biological sources.

clauses.title: Inference scope
clauses.normative_statement: Inference scope derives from query, source diversity, protocol, external replication, exposure or interference, and profile coverage; not from numerosity alone.

required_predicates.rationale: Factor, contrast, endpoint, timepoint, estimand, and population define scope.
Confirmed source diversity qualifies source-level generalization.
Protocol and execution context bound inference.
External replication status must be explicit.
Exposure and interference consequences must be retained.
Profile predicate coverage and known gaps must be declared.

forbidden_inferences: Do not infer generalization from experimental-unit count or raw numerosity alone.

review_requirements.rationale: Reviewed theory references and real derivation gold are not yet available.
